items.title: 3 Top Picks With At Least 2% Dividend Yield
items.summary: The recent US midterm election shock pulled attention and capital away from AI heavyweights and oil producers. That shift puts the spotlight back on steady, low carbon power sources like nuclear energy that can run regardless of politics or fuel headlines. For investors, this creates an opening to reassess long term clean power exposure. This article examines three nuclear focused stocks that may warrant closer attention from that perspective.
